title: Earth entered its 'bad decades' after dinosaur-ending asteroid strike | New Scientist
description: We now have a clearer picture of what happened in the decades following the asteroid impact that led to the extinction of almost all dinosaurs
author: James Woodford

title: All tropical coral reefs could collapse within 50 years | New Scientist
description: Shallow-water coral reefs are at high risk of disappearing by 2075, the IUCN has warned at a UN biodiversity conference. The loss would decimate fisheries and speed up coastal erosion
author: Alec Luhn

title: Adults may be more creative than children – but less confident about it | New Scientist
description: We often associate children with creativity, but adults actually performed better on inventive tasks, despite being less sure of themselves
author: Carissa Wong

title: Global race to update computers as AI discovers most disruptive hack yet | New Scientist
description: More than two thirds of the world's websites are vulnerable to a hack that was first theorised in 2024, which AI has now made very real
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Cholesterol may disrupt the brain's cleaning system in Alzheimer's disease | New Scientist
description: The glymphatic system flushes toxins out of the brain, but this seems to be disrupted in Alzheimer's disease, and cholesterol may be involved
author: Michael Marshall

title: Digital scents could add a new dimension to virtual worlds | New Scientist
description: It's now possible to convert a handful of smells into electronic signals that can be sent through the internet
author: Jo Marchant
